expedition_space.wrong_dimension: This facility cannot operate in this dimension.
expedition_space.owned: Another expedition team owns this endpoint.
expedition_space.already_bound: This team already has this facility here. Load the original location and remove its controller before moving it.
expedition_space.bound: Endpoint bound to your expedition team.
expedition_space.launch_slots: Load the first eight slots in row one. Receive in row two. In row three insert a carrier and a fuel bucket in the first two slots.
expedition_space.cargo_slots: Load the first eight slots in row one and collect in row two. Use the freight controller to dispatch or sneak-use it to toggle automation.
expedition_space.no_beacon: Activate a freight beacon on this planet’s surface first.
expedition_space.dungeon_missing: No lunar dungeon within scan range.
expedition_space.dungeon: Lunar dungeon at %s. Enter its structure to survey it.
expedition_space.no_cargo: Load cargo or wait for the dispatch cooldown.
expedition_space.need_endpoints: Check both endpoints and their satellite registrations.
expedition_space.active_shipment: The previous shipment is awaiting delivery.
expedition_space.fuel: The launchpad needs a carrier rocket or a reusable freight carrier, and a bucket of rocket fuel.
expedition_space.dispatched: Cargo accepted. It will arrive when the destination is available.
expedition_space.need_visit: Visit the destination in person, bind both endpoints and register the beacon. The other endpoint must be loaded.
expedition_space.blocked: There is no safe landing position at the destination.
expedition_space.surveyed: Lunar dungeon surveyed. Keep the signature to return from The Other.
expedition_space.gate_locked: Complete three freight deliveries across both directions and survey the dungeon in person.
expedition_space.return_pad: The lunar landing is blocked. Use the native Other teleport pad to return to the Nether.
expedition_space.pad_locked: Use the lunar gate for your first expedition to The Other.
expedition_space.recovered: Cargo recovered to the source receiving slots in %s at %s.
expedition_space.upgrade_offhand: Hold the matching armor or canister pack in your off hand and use the module in the air.
expedition_space.already_upgraded: This part already has the upgrade.
expedition_space.reserve_set: The first canister slot is now reserved for breathing. Fill it with Natural Air.
expedition_space.air_low: Approximately %s seconds of breathing air remain.
